scimapR 0.1.0

A comprehensive toolkit for bibliometric and scientometric analysis, designed as a complement to the foundational 'bibliometrix' package (Aria & Cuccurullo, 2017, <doi:10.1016/j.joi.2017.08.007>). Provides unified ingestion from major bibliographic sources including 'OpenAlex', 'Crossref', 'Semantic Scholar', 'PubMed', 'arXiv', 'bioRxiv', 'ORCID', 'Overton', 'Unpaywall', 'Scopus', and 'Web of Science' exports; classical science mapping (co-citation, bibliographic coupling, co-authorship, co-word networks); modern citation indicators (CD index, Relative Citation Ratio, field-normalized scores, Uzzi novelty); embedding-based research cluster discovery; structured research-question objects with optional LLM-grounded screening; author trajectory analysis; equity and representation auditing with explicit confidence and method reporting; reproducible-by-construction corpus certificates enabling exact re-derivation of a corpus; retrieval-grounded conversational corpus exploration; and a comprehensive 'shiny' application with publication-ready figure and table export. Output is fully 'tidyverse'-compatible with tibble-based corpora, 'viridis'-themed 'ggplot2' visualizations, and 'tidygraph' network objects.
